title: St. Andrew Dung-Lac, Priest, and Companions, Martyrs
subtitle: Memorial · Rev 14:14-19; Lk 21:5-11
text: Between 1745 and 1862, thousands of Catholics in Vietnam died for the faith. St. John Paul II canonized 117 of them in 1988: priests, catechists, farmers, soldiers and mothers, most of them Vietnamese, along with Spanish and French missionaries. Ordered to trample the cross, they would not. Pray today for Christians who still suffer for their faith.
